title: Three Evenings and One Short Letter
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：occasion　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 occasion 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the counsellor ① marked the occasion that no listener in the garden would have recorded, and he said the marking was the whole of the evening. The ② occasion, meaning the moment itself and not the letter, ran three evenings and stayed unrecorded in the book; an occasion, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ occasion in that garden had the same short letter beside it, and the ④ occasion at the far bench, meaning the secret they kept for the children to tell and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An occasion, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the counsellor said the recording is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the occasion was the whole of the matter, meaning the meaning and not the moment. The ⑥ occasion, meaning the meaning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; occasion, he said, is either something you mark or the only word that means both a moment and a meaning. He said the meaning is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ occasion had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short letter. The ⑧ occasion of the whole thing, the counsellor wrote in June, was one garden and three evenings of recording; occasion, he said, is either the secret at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ occasion I remember is the moment recorded in the journal, which closed in 1966 and is still recorded as the quietest in the garden. An ⑩ occasion, my mother said in 1968, is the only moment that improves by being recorded; every occasion, she said, is a meaning that has agreed to look like a moment. She said the meaning was the honest half.

answers.why: mark the occasion 意为“记念这一个场合”，1959 年那位谈心人把小园里没有一位倾听者肯记载的一个场合做了一遍。
occasion 意为“场合；时机”，指那个场合本身而不是薄薄的信，它经过了三个黄昏而在簿子上没有被记载。
occasion 意为“场合；时机”，指小园里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一封薄薄的信。
occasion 意为“场合；时机”，指最远那张长椅的留给孩子们说出的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
occasion 意为“场合、礼数”，指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个礼数就是那件事的全部。
occasion 意为“礼数”，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个场合，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
occasion 意为“场合；时机”，指心记里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1964 年这一个成了心记里的一行。
occasion 意为“场合之事”，谈心人六月写道，整件事的场合之事是一处小园和三个黄昏的记载。
occasion 意为“场合；时机”，我记得的是心记里记载过的那一个，1966 年说尽了，至今仍被说成小园里最安静的一个。
occasion 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，场合是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的场合。
